featured_reviews.name: Everything On A Plate EOAP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked inside on the 1st floor of cosmo square, it's sadly quite easy to miss!

It was one of the first playzones in the area so it was a rage. But now with the new zones emerging this space may fall behind.

They have quite a few activities - slides, ball pit, car zoom, swings, wall climbing trampoline etc but it's sadly not maintained. Thought it's not "unclean" the broken ball pit, crumbling sponge does make your heart jitter a bit.

Then again the space is decently sized, rates are a steal, there are some refreshments and the staff (Pranali and Prajwal) here is incredibly attentive and kind. We even bumped into a few regulars and the conversations we overheard sounded like people are really happy with the space.

Ultimately it boils down to what you are willing to overlook and how much fun your kid has. Our kid has a blast but the ball pit will definitely make us do a double take.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Prasad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Nanhe Sitare for the first time with our 3-year-old daughter so she could enjoy and do some activities. On arrival, they registered her name and asked us to buy socks — but did not inform us that several things were not working.

The ACs were not functioning, the ball machine was off, the gas station setup was just for show, and there were no cars available for kids to ride. We paid ₹250 for an hour expecting the full experience, but it turned out to be just slides and ball play — not worth the price.

When I asked about the non-working equipment, the staff said it all stopped working “from today,” which felt hard to believe since multiple things were out of order at once.

The two girls assisting were kind and did try to make my daughter enjoy, but the management should be more transparent and ensure all equipment is functional before charging visitors. Overall, quite disappointed with the experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Suraj,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We truly regret that your experience did not meet expectations. We take such comments seriously and are already working on improving transparency regarding any equipment that may be temporarily non-functional so that parents are clearly informed
Our team is reviewing the concerns you highlighted about the AC, ball machine, gas station setup, and car rides to ensure such issues do not recur. We are also glad to know that our staff tried their best to make your daughter comfortable.

We appreciate your visit and hope to offer a much better experience in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at this gaming zone! 🎮🔥
The place is a complete entertainment hub — from well-maintained snooker and pool tables to high-performance PlayStation setups, everything is top-notch. The table tennis area is equally fun and perfect for a quick competitive match with friends.
What really stands out is the VIP snooker lounge — premium feel, शांत वातावरण, and perfect for serious players who want a more private and classy experience.
The ambience is lively, equipment is in excellent condition, and the overall vibe makes you want to stay longer. Whether you’re coming to chill, compete, or just hang out with friends, this place delivers on every level.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun and premium gaming experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
